title: GateEditRequest
description: Body of POST /approvals/:id/edit (decided in #85, was #146). Unsigned: it creates a new pending intent with editedFrom set and marks the original rejected (edited). The response is a GatePrepareApproval for the new intent, which the device then signs, so one Face ID prompt covers the edit. An edit that changes the tier is refused with tier_changed, one policy forbids with forbidden.

intent.description: The whole edited intent ({ kind, args }), of the same kind as the original. The gate validates it against the intent schemas.
